# libphonenumber-js

Pinned version: 1.13.15

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/libphonenumber-js/v/1.13.15

The unmodified `bundle/libphonenumber-min.js` is vendored locally so booking
forms do not depend on a third-party CDN. It includes the minimal numbering-plan
metadata used to distinguish national trunk prefixes from significant zeros.
